en.title: Two's Power (Regex Match)
en.description:
Determine whether the positive integer represented by a binary string is a power of 2. Leading zeros are allowed; zero itself is not a power of 2. The original problem asks for a regex match; this problem turns the locked match result into the standard output True/False.

The input/output protocol and the explicitly marked constraints added by this site were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty binary string s (length 1..200000; a bound added by this site).
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach and proof.
